deploy.description: Zapier Manager 'New Authentication' on the work.flowers account -> DM Dennis on Slack when someone other than him adds a connection. Migrated from the classic Zap of the same name, with a richer message (real app from selected_api, connection label, who added it, when, auth id).

trigger.trigger_note: Zapier Manager 'New Authentication' — a polling (read) trigger, no auth (it monitors the account it runs under). `account` 20491667 is the work.flowers Zapier account in Zapier Manager's namespace (distinct from the 20495893 catch-hook account id in CLAUDE.md).
